name: Learn a cartwheel
blurb: A cartwheel is a sideways handstand passed through. It is the gateway to every other tumbling skill and a genuinely useful way to bail out of a handstand.
gear: A straight line on the ground to follow
steps: Learn a lunge: front leg bent, arms up by the ears, hips square to the direction of travel.
Practise the hand placement pattern — hand, hand, foot, foot — slowly along a line, hands turned sideways.
Kick over with a straight leading leg, passing through a momentary sideways handstand.
Work on staying on the line: hands and feet should all land on it.
Finish standing upright in a lunge facing the way you came, arms up.
Learn it on both sides — the second side takes a fraction of the time.
tips: Bent arms are what collapse a cartwheel. Push the floor away hard.
Slow it right down first. Speed hides poor hand placement until the day it does not.
proof: A cartwheel on both sides, staying on a straight line, with straight arms and legs.
